evidence.detail: prime_cache() updates legal_formats in deck_cache but is only called on deck creation/update — no periodic refresh exists
Daily reprime_cache task runs preaggregate functions but does NOT call prime_cache() per deck — legal_formats in deck_cache can become arbitrarily stale
deck_cache schema has no cached_date column — bakert's proposed tracking mechanism was never implemented
bakert confirmed in comments: 949aaad removed per-deck repriming in 2020 due to 30-minute runtime; explored 1/50th batch (3513 decks, ~few seconds) and proposed cached_date column approach

triage.notes: Root cause is clear and confirmed by code. Fix requires design decisions: batch size per day, whether to add a cached_date column (schema migration) for LRU ordering, and whether to fold it into rotation or run as a separate daily task. Per-deck prime_cache has cumulative performance risk at scale.
